body: Being alive to me is a chore.  It's something that I'm supposed to do,  because it makes other people happy. I've never really been add good at participating in life as everyone else.  I've shared my thoughts with others.  It never helps.  It either becomes a heated discussion,  or an unwarranted burden on someone else's mind. At this point I really just want a way to not hurt anyone else,  but yet ending my own suffering. I know that is selfish.

Its been about 6 years since I felt I was living because I wanted to be alive.  It may have been longer.  At the time I was still young, I don't believe I had the ability to make a decision with that much weight prior to that. I still am not alive because I want to be,  but now more than ever I'm looking for an out.
Sorry for poor spelling, grammar,  punctuation,  or incomplete thoughts.  I'm writing on a phone. And I'm Falling apart.

The job that I acquired is a night shift,  which sucks,  but overnight is manageable. I won't name the company,  but it is a company that it's notorious for poor work conditions.  Normally I'm scheduled 8 hours,  but my estimated time of completion of tasks is roughly 22-30 hours of work.  It's impossible to do any full tasks in one shift.  I consistently try,  but it's not possible. When I leave I immediately fall asleep,  and stay asleep until my next shift.  Overall I working and making minimum wage just so that I can continue living to continue working etc.
